game_start.intro: Ciyaarta ayaa bilaabmaysa. Dabaal Trump: {trump_suit} (kaarka trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee Jarmalka Whist. {phase_info} Waxaad haysataa {hand_size} kaararka. Ciyaar kaarka leh '[play N]', halka N uu yahay booska uu ku jiro gacantaada (tusaale ahaan '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: DAQIIQADA BARASHADA: guuleystaha khiyaano kasta wuxuu qaataa kaarka wajiga ka soo horjeeda iyo kan khasaaray wuxuu ka soo saaraa kaarka xiga ee kaarka.
player_prompt.phase_playing: Xili ciyaareed: gunti waa la dhammeeyey. Qalad kasta oo hadda ka dib la ciyaaro waxay u dhigantaa guusha.

next_card.playing_phase: Kaar la soo bandhigi maayo - ciyaarta ayaa bilaabatay.
next_card.deck_empty: Kaararka waa madhan yihiin - wax kaar ah lama siinayo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Qaabka dhaqaaq aan sax ahayn. Isticmaal '[play N]' si aad u ciyaarto kaarka Nth ee gacantaada.
invalid_move.bad_position: Kaarkaas booskiisa ma jiro. Waxaad haysaa kaararka {hand_size}.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Waa in aad raacdaa oo aad ciyaartaa kaar {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Ciyaaryahanka {winner_id} ayaa ku guuleysta khiyaamada {card} wuxuuna qaataa kaarka wajiga ka soo horjeeda.

phase.learning_complete: Qeybta wax barashadu waa dhamaatay - wax kasta oo ku soo haray waxay u xisaabtamayaan guusha.

draw.winner_received: Waxaad ku guuleysatay khiyaamada waxaadna heshay {card}.
draw.loser_received: Waxaad lumisay khiyaano oo waxaad ka soo saartay {card} boosteejada.
draw.winner_preview: Kaarka soo socda ee la soo bandhigay waa {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Qodobbada la guuleystay ilaa hadda - Ciyaaryahanka 0: {tricks0}, Ciyaaryahanka 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Waxba kama jiraan kaararka ciyaaray weli xeeladkan.
